commit.message:
Add a Dart benchmark example and run it in CI

The example package defines benchmark_harness benchmarks and tests;
CI now formats, analyzes and tests it, and the benchmark workflow
tracks it as its own suite next to the Node example. The run command
now uses pipefail so a failing benchmark piped through tee fails.

commit.message:
Keep a single, reactive benchmark comment per pull request

All suites now share one comment. It shows a loading state before the
benchmarks run, then each suite's section is edited in place as its
results (or failure) arrive. The state lives in a hidden HTML comment so
concurrent jobs merge their own section, with read-back and retry for
concurrent writes. The comment workflow also runs when a benchmark run
is requested, so fork pull requests get the loading state, and marks
suites that never reported once the run completes.
